name: Wode AI Nuyou
source:
This...this fierce-looking chav girl is supposed to be my AI girlfriend? What! Housework module required a top-up? Cooking mod and sex mod too?! Although the AI girlfriend was a product of capitalism, it was not without its benefits. As for what benefits it was, you could only find out in the game~

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3122910]Steam[/url]]
